children: SCWorx completed a private placement of common stock and warrants for gross proceeds of $938,000, selling 350,000 shares and warrants for 350,000 shares at a combined $2.68 per unit. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $2.56 and expire five years from issuance. Proceeds will be held in a segregated account for 90 days, with investor rescission rights if Nasdaq trading does not resume by Oct. 31, 2026. Separately, SCWorx engaged Dawson James as exclusive placement agent for 12 months, issuing 49,860 fee shares and agreeing to cash fees tied to the offering and future transactions.
